facts.fact: Bluesquare says 12 of the 21 health centres assessed across Nouakchott, Trarza and Brakna are confirmed as pilot sites for OpenClinic GA, the recommended shared primary care record, ahead of a first deployment at Dar Naim health centre.

Bluesquare says the DIGISANTE MRT programme agreed HL7 FHIR R4, a national patient identifier and harmonised terminologies as the foundation for health system interoperability and identified patient, workforce, facility, insurance and pharmaceutical registries plus a DHIS2 export layer; a national steering unit first met in July 2026.
